heroHeadline: Family of Renee Good Files Lawsuit Against Trump Administration Over Fatal ICE Shooting
heroSubtitle: The family of Renee Good filed a federal lawsuit against the Trump administration and immigration officials over her fatal shooting by ICE agents, adding to a growing wave of legal challenges over deadly ICE enforcement. Earlier on Oct 1, the Supreme Court agreed to review the mandatory detention policy denying bond hearings to immigrants, and the DOJ sued Maryland and two counties over laws barring ICE agents from wearing masks.
